title: make bg full bleed going to edge of message border
summary: I'll shade every cell of the frame, the border rows and border columns included, so the background runs out to the border's outer edge.The user message background now fills the whole box, including the border itself. Before, the border lines and the two border rows sat on the chat background with an unshaded strip around the inside. Now every cell from the outer edge of the border inward is shade…
